author: Monty

pump.power_mW: declared at bench; pair rate per mW is a measured brightness, not derived here

crystal.oven_c: heated above room ambient, typically 25 to 60; heating is recorded, never cooling

pairs.polarization: orthogonal (type-II); polarizing splitter separates herald and signal

filtering: bandpass at 810 nm on both arms, width chosen to bring b toward a (purity law); single-mode fibre on both arms

detector.design_change: signal wavelength near 810 nm: new SPDC crystal/pump, re-targeted SiN cross-section and MMI, new calibration

herald: idler click within a declared window heralds one signal photon; threshold detector

operating_point.rationale: g2 = 2x lossless; x = 1/40 gives g2 = 1/20 with 1/40 conditional multi-pair

exact_laws: heralded g2 = 2x (lossless herald), closed form for any herald efficiency
Klyshko ratio C/S_i -> eta_s, exact multi-pair correction
temperature: pump diode, crystal oven, detectors all at or above the room band floor; crystal oven temperature is itself a sweep variable
boundaries: pair rate, brightness, efficiencies and bandwidths are declared, not derived
HOM visibility is bounded above by purity; its value is measured, not predicted
N heralded sources succeed together with probability p^N: the fusion network note handles multiplexing
nothing here changes the temperature verdict, which grades recorded logs only
